description: Main source file for a Flutter note-taking app. It defines the app's main widget, themes, navigation, and core logic for handling notes, including search, add, edit, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: NotesApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up themes and initial app state, including theme toggling.

classes.name: NotesHomePage
classes.description: Main page managing the display of notes, search, navigation, and theme toggling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, initializes Flutter binding and runs the app.

methods.name: _toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark theme modes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp with the selected theme and home page.

methods.name: _getNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the database based on current search query.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Updates the notes list when the search query changes.

methods.name: _onDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note and refreshes the list.

methods.name: _onEditNote
methods.description: Navigates to note editing page and updates note upon return.

methods.name: _onAddNote
methods.description: Navigates to the note creation page and adds new note.

methods.name: _onNoteTap
methods.description: Opens note details page on note tap.

methods.name: _notesListBuilder
methods.description: Builds the list of notes, handling loading, errors, and empty states.

methods.name: _mainContentWidget
methods.description: Chooses the main content view based on navigation index.
